rows.en: Whoa...!! Why...? I can't muster any strength!!
Uuugh...!! Why...? I can't muster any strength!!
Whoa...!! Why...? I can't muster any strength!!
You were beaten the moment you laid eyes on me... beaten by my fear. By TERROR!!
Too bad for you, but that doesn't work so well on me!!
...Oh? ...Kamen Rider Accel, is it? It seems you're simply built that way, hm?
But do you really think Terror is a Dopant that only attacks the mind!?
For you, allow me to break it down! Physically!!
Come, Garagaranda. Let us leave the rest to Ikadevil and Shocker Greeed.
The device on the Gaia Gate, right? Leave it to me...!!
Birth destroyed the device that had been attached to the Gaia Gate.
And that... takes care of that. So there are two more of these things, huh...
That's right... We have to hurry... Let's find the other Gaia Gates and destroy their devices.
Hey, wait! Accel!! You're planning to go in that condition!?
Let me say this as a doctor: you're seriously injured. You need treatment back at base.
No buts!! I'm taking you back!!
...All right. Everyone, I'm counting on you for the rest.
Rest easy! Leave it to us!!
We'll be fine. Leave it to us!
We'll be fine. Leave it to us!
We'll be fine. Leave it to us!
We'll be fine. Please leave it to us!
We'll be fine. Leave it to us!
It'll be fine, please leave it to us!
No problem, no problem!! Just leave it to me!!
We'll be fine. Leave it to us!
We'll be fine. Leave it to us!
We'll be fine. Leave it to us!
We'll be fine. Leave it to us!
We'll be fine. Leave it to us!
Tch, stairs going up... The other Gaia Gates are on this floor too, aren't they?
I don't know about that. Let's just go and see.
That I don't know. Right now, we've got no choice but to keep going.
How the hell would I know? There's a path, so we take it! That's all there is to it!!
Who knows... But hey, right now I guess we've gotta keep going.
I can't say for sure... But for now, I think we have no choice but to go on.
I don't know... But turning back won't do us any good.
No idea... But for now, we just have to keep going, right?
I don't know... But for now, we must press on.

notes.note: #0.160-164 are slots 11-15 of the 15-slot leader block begun at #0.150 (story_104): the party is struck by Terror's fear and loses strength. Voiced by wording; identical Japanese -> identical English. Slot pattern across this event: slots 3-7 look like the Ultras (identical 'watashi'/katakana-grunt lines, slot 6 polite = Mebius, slot 7 rough = Zero), slot 8 polite = OOO, slot 9 brash (Momotaros-like), slots 11-15 Gundams. Inferred, not verified from script.
Wordplay: Terror's name is the English word for the 'fear' he inflicts; rendered 'beaten by my fear. By TERROR!!'.
Refers to Accel (Terui) being resistant to Terror's fear by nature; 'built that way' keeps the source's vague 'that kind of constitution'.

Pun: the verb means both 'chew to pieces' and 'explain in simple terms', followed by 'physically'. Rendered 'allow me to break it down! Physically!!' to keep the double meaning and Terror's mock-polite register.

#0.174-188: 15-slot leader block (name + pained grunt; they are still weakened). Honorific '-san' on Accel in #0.179/#0.181 dropped per style rule; politeness has no room to show in a bare name + grunt. Trailing full-width space after #0.182's exclamation dropped.
'Hero shokun' (mocking address to the heroes) rendered 'heroes'; story_104 #0.149 (not yet translated) has the same address and should match.
#0.192-206: leader block; plain rows 'Are you okay!?', the two polite rows (#0.197, #0.199, '-san' + desu) 'Are you all right!?'.
Birth's 'two more' = the other two Gaia Gate devices (Terror said three Gaia Gates are being drained, story_104 #0.125).
Birth (Date) is an ex-doctor; 'kyoten' rendered 'base' per glossary UI term.
Direction: Accel asking the party to handle the rest -> 'I'm counting on you'.

#0.217-230: 14-slot leader block answering Accel's request ('everyone'). Object dropped in the source; restored as 'us' (leader speaking for the team) except #0.225, which explicitly says 'me'. Polite rows #0.222/#0.224 get 'please'.
Ankh, seeing stairs up, asks whether the remaining Gaia Gates are on this same floor; the leaders answer they don't know.

#0.2-15 leader block continues into story_106 (#0.10-15 there). Voiced by wording: #0.2 gentle (OOO-like), #0.4 brash (Momotaros-like), #0.5 casual (Shotaro-like), #0.6 polite (Mebius-like). Slot order not verified.

report: 80/80 rows examined. Leader-variant blocks (#0.160-164, #0.174-188, #0.192-206, #0.217-230, 0582 #0.2-9) voiced by wording; slot-to-hero mapping inferred, not script-verified. Puns kept: #0.165 fear/Terror, #0.172 'break it down... physically'. #0.217-230 dropped object restored as 'us'. #0.189 'heroes' should match story_104 #0.149. No new names or terms.
